name: synaptic-go
description: Synaptic Go — Egypt ride-hailing on Cloudflare

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @synaptic-go/api && npm run typecheck -w @synaptic-go/admin
scripts.check: python3 scripts/check_migrations.py && python3 scripts/check_migrations_apply.py && python3 scripts/check_l10n_parity.py && python3 scripts/check_repo_hygiene.py
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck -w @synaptic-go/api && npm run typecheck -w @synaptic-go/admin && npm run typecheck -w @synaptic-go/shared && npm run build -w @synaptic-go/admin && npm test && npm run check
